part.text:
## Answer

**Yes.** ripgrep's special ignore-file name used to be **`.rgignore`**, not `.ignore`.

The commit in this repository's history that establishes the answer is:

**`cc90511ab29d3c37e873acac0fd80f90473f54bb`** — "Switch from .rgignore to .ignore."

### Supporting quotes from that commit

Commit message (subject and body):

> **Switch from .rgignore to .ignore.**
>
> But don't actually remove support for .rgignore until the next semver
> bump.
>
> Note that this puts us in line with the silver searcher:
> https://github.com/ggreer/the_silver_searcher/pull/974
>
> Fixes #40

The diff itself shows the old name being replaced, e.g. in `src/ignore.rs`:

```diff
 const IGNORE_NAMES: &'static [&'static str] = &[
     ".gitignore",
+    ".ignore",
     ".rgignore",
 ];
```

and in `README.md`:

```diff
-The above command also respects all `.rgignore` files, including in parent
-directories. `.rgignore` files can be used when `.gitignore` files are
-insufficient. In all cases, `.rgignore` patterns take precedence over
+The above command also respects all `.ignore` files, including in parent
+directories. `.ignore` files can be used when `.gitignore` files are
+insufficient. In all cases, `.ignore` patterns take precedence over
 `.gitignore`.
```

### Additional corroboration from history

The name `.rgignore` goes back to ripgrep's very first commits — `git grep` at `a744ec1` ("Rename xrep to ripgrep.") shows `.rgignore` in `src/ignore.rs` (`const IGNORE_NAMES` containing `".rgignore"`, plus `$HOME/.rgignore` in a doc comment). Commit `cc90511` (dated 2016-09-23) then switched the canonical name to `.ignore`, while deliberately keeping `.rgignore` support for backward compatibility until the next semver bump.

No files were modified.
